## Yemen Real Estate Portal v2.4.0

A Flutter Arabic-first real-estate portal backed by Supabase.

### Highlights
- Full i18n (Arabic/English) across ~30 screens
- Location-first dashboard: nearby properties filtered to user city (Ibb fallback)
- Map zooms to user location
- Screen-specific titles + back button in AppHeader
- Footer hidden on mobile/tablet
- Dark-theme readability fixes
- Performance: demo properties generated once via late final
- My Properties overflow fixed

### Verification
- flutter analyze: No issues found
- flutter test: 56/56 passing

### Download
Android APK attached below (app-release.apk).
